verses.original: δὲ Περὶ τῆς λογείας τῆς εἰς τοὺς ἁγίους οὕτως ὑμεῖς ποιήσατε καὶ ὥσπερ διέταξα ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις τῆς Γαλατίας
verses.transliteration: de Peri tēs logeias tēs eis tous hagious houtōs hymeis poiēsate kai hōsper dietaxa tais ekklēsiais tēs Galatias
verses.literal: Now about the collection - for the saints - you are to do vvv as I directed the churches - of Galatia

verses.original: μίαν κατὰ σαββάτου ἕκαστος ὑμῶν τιθέτω παρ’ ἑαυτῷ ἐὰν εὐοδῶται θησαυρίζων ὅ¦τι ἵνα ὅταν ἔλθω τότε μὴ λογεῖαι γίνωνται
verses.transliteration: mian kata sabbatou hekastos hymōn tithetō par’ heautō ean euodōtai thēsaurizōn ho¦ti hina hotan elthō tote mē logeiai ginōntai
verses.literal: On the first [day] of every week each of you should set aside . . . a portion of his income saving it up . . . so that when I come - no collections will be needed

verses.original: δὲ ὅταν παραγένωμαι πέμψω ἐπιστολῶν δι’ τούτους οὓς ἐὰν δοκιμάσητε ἀπενεγκεῖν ὑμῶν τὴν χάριν εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ
verses.transliteration: de hotan paragenōmai pempsō epistolōn di’ toutous hous ean dokimasēte apenenkein hymōn tēn charin eis Ierousalēm
verses.literal: Then vvv on my arrival I will send letters with those . . . vvv you recommend to carry your - gift to Jerusalem

verses.original: δὲ ἐὰν ᾖ ἄξιον τοῦ κἀμὲ πορεύεσθαι πορεύσονται σὺν ἐμοὶ
verses.transliteration: de ean ē axion tou kame poreuesthai poreusontai syn emoi
verses.literal: And if it is advisable for me to go {also} they can travel with me

verses.original: ὅταν διέλθω Μακεδονίαν δὲ Ἐλεύσομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς γὰρ διέρχομαι Μακεδονίαν
verses.transliteration: hotan dielthō Makedonian de Eleusomai pros hymas gar dierchomai Makedonian
verses.literal: After I go through Macedonia however I will come to you for I will be going through Macedonia

verses.original: δὲ τυχὸν παραμενῶ πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἢ καὶ παραχειμάσω ἵνα ὑμεῖς προπέμψητε με οὗ ἐὰν πορεύωμαι
verses.transliteration: de tychon paramenō pros hymas ē kai paracheimasō hina hymeis propempsēte me hou ean poreuōmai
verses.literal: vvv Perhaps I will stay with you {awhile} or even spend the winter so that you can help me {on my journey} wherever vvv I go

verses.original: γὰρ οὐ θέλω ἰδεῖν ὑμᾶς ἄρτι ἐν παρόδῳ γὰρ ἐλπίζω ἐπιμεῖναι τινὰ χρόνον πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐὰν ὁ Κύριος ἐπιτρέψῃ
verses.transliteration: gar ou thelō idein hymas arti en parodō gar elpizō epimeinai tina chronon pros hymas ean ho Kyrios epitrepsē
verses.literal: For vvv I do not want to see you now [only] in passing - I hope to spend some time with you if the Lord permits

verses.original: δὲ ἐπιμενῶ ἐν Ἐφέσῳ ἕως τῆς Πεντηκοστῆς
verses.transliteration: de epimenō en Ephesō heōs tēs Pentēkostēs
verses.literal: But I will stay in Ephesus until - Pentecost

verses.original: γάρ μεγάλη θύρα καὶ ἐνεργής ἀνέῳγεν μοι καὶ πολλοί ἀντικείμενοι
verses.transliteration: gar megalē thyra kai energēs aneōgen moi kai polloi antikeimenoi
verses.literal: because a great door [for] effective [work] has opened to me even though many oppose [me]

verses.original: δὲ Ἐὰν Τιμόθεος ἔλθῃ βλέπετε ἵνα γένηται ἀφόβως πρὸς ὑμᾶς γὰρ ἐργάζεται τὸ ἔργον Κυρίου ὡς κἀγώ
verses.transliteration: de Ean Timotheos elthē blepete hina genētai aphobōs pros hymas gar ergazetai to ergon Kyriou hōs kagō
verses.literal: - If Timothy comes see to it that he has nothing to fear [while he is] with you for he is doing the work of [the] Lord just as I am

verses.original: μή τις οὖν ἐξουθενήσῃ αὐτὸν δὲ προπέμψατε αὐτὸν ἐν εἰρήνῃ ἵνα ἔλθῃ πρός με γὰρ ἐκδέχομαι αὐτὸν μετὰ τῶν ἀδελφῶν
verses.transliteration: mē tis oun exouthenēsē auton de propempsate auton en eirēnē hina elthē pros me gar ekdechomai auton meta tōn adelphōn
verses.literal: No one then should treat him with contempt . . . - Send him {on his way} in peace so that he can return to me for I am expecting him along with the brothers

verses.original: δὲ Περὶ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ Ἀπολλῶ παρεκάλεσα πολλὰ αὐτὸν ἵνα ἔλθῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς μετὰ τῶν ἀδελφῶν καὶ ἦν οὐκ πάντως θέλημα ἵνα ἔλθῃ νῦν δὲ ἐλεύσεται ὅταν εὐκαιρήσῃ
verses.transliteration: de Peri tou adelphou Apollō parekalesa polla auton hina elthē pros hymas meta tōn adelphōn kai ēn ouk pantōs thelēma hina elthē nyn de eleusetai hotan eukairēsē
verses.literal: Now about [our] brother Apollos I strongly urged . . . him to go to you with the brothers - He was not at all inclined to go now but he will go when he has the opportunity

verses.original: Γρηγορεῖτε στήκετε ἐν τῇ πίστει ἀνδρίζεσθε κραταιοῦσθε
verses.transliteration: Grēgoreite stēkete en tē pistei andrizesthe krataiousthe
verses.literal: Be on the alert Stand firm in the faith Be men of courage Be strong

verses.original: γινέσθω πάντα ὑμῶν ἐν ἀγάπῃ
verses.transliteration: ginesthō panta hymōn en agapē
verses.literal: Do everything - in love

verses.original: οἴδατε ὅτι Στεφανᾶ τὴν οἰκίαν ἐστὶν ἀπαρχὴ τῆς Ἀχαΐας καὶ ἔταξαν ἑαυτούς εἰς διακονίαν τοῖς ἁγίοις δὲ Παρακαλῶ ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί
verses.transliteration: oidate hoti Stephana tēn oikian estin aparchē tēs Achaias kai etaxan heautous eis diakonian tois hagiois de Parakalō hymas adelphoi
verses.literal: You know that Stephanas [and his] household were [the] first converts - in Achaia and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints Now I urge you brothers

verses.original: ἵνα ὑμεῖς καὶ ὑποτάσσησθε τοῖς τοιούτοις καὶ παντὶ τῷ συνεργοῦντι καὶ κοπιῶντι
verses.transliteration: hina hymeis kai hypotassēsthe tois toioutois kai panti tō synergounti kai kopiōnti
verses.literal: to - - submit - to such as these and to every - fellow worker and laborer

verses.original: δὲ Χαίρω Στεφανᾶ καὶ Φορτουνάτου καὶ Ἀχαϊκοῦ ἐπὶ τῇ παρουσίᾳ ὅτι οὗτοι ἀνεπλήρωσαν τὸ ὑστέρημα ὑμέτερον
verses.transliteration: de Chairō Stephana kai Phortounatou kai Achaikou epi tē parousia hoti houtoi aneplērōsan to hysterēma hymeteron
verses.literal: - I am glad that Stephanas - Fortunatus and Achaicus vvv vvv have arrived because they have supplied what was lacking from you

verses.original: γὰρ ἀνέπαυσαν ἐμὸν τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ τὸ ὑμῶν ἐπιγινώσκετε οὖν τοὺς τοιούτους
verses.transliteration: gar anepausan emon to pneuma kai to hymōn epiginōskete oun tous toioutous
verses.literal: For they refreshed my - spirit and - yours {as well} Show your appreciation therefore - to such men

verses.original: αἱ ἐκκλησίαι τῆς Ἀσίας Ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς Ἀκύλας καὶ Πρίσκα Ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς πολλὰ ἐν Κυρίῳ σὺν τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ κατ’ αὐτῶν οἶκον
verses.transliteration: hai ekklēsiai tēs Asias Aspazontai hymas Akylas kai Priska Aspazetai hymas polla en Kyriō syn tē ekklēsia kat’ autōn oikon
verses.literal: The churches - in [the province of] Asia send you greetings . . . Aquila and Prisca greet you warmly in [the] Lord and so does the church [that meets] at their house

verses.original: πάντες οἱ ἀδελφοὶ Ἀσπάζονται ὑμᾶς Ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν ἁγίῳ φιλήματι
verses.transliteration: pantes hoi adelphoi Aspazontai hymas Aspasasthe allēlous en hagiō philēmati
verses.literal: All the brothers [here] send you greetings . . . Greet one another with a holy kiss

verses.original: Ὁ ἀσπασμὸς τῇ ἐμῇ χειρὶ Παύλου
verses.transliteration: Ho aspasmos tē emē cheiri Paulou
verses.literal: This greeting [is in my] own hand Paul

verses.original: Εἴ τις οὐ φιλεῖ τὸν Κύριον ἤτω ἀνάθεμα Μαράνα θά
verses.transliteration: Ei tis ou philei ton Kyrion ētō anathema Marana tha
verses.literal: If anyone {does} not love the Lord let him be under a curse Come O Lord

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ μεθ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Hē charis tou Kyriou Iēsou meth’ hymōn
verses.literal: The grace of the Lord Jesus [be] with you

verses.original: μου Ἡ ἀγάπη μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ Ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: mou Hē agapē meta pantōn hymōn en Christō Iēsou Amēn
verses.literal: My - love [be] with all of you in Christ Jesus Amen
